Fixed_Base_1.description: Amateur simplex/calling, APRS and ISS/space memories, followed by the first three NOAA Weather Radio channels. (CH1-19)

Fixed_Base_2.description: Remaining NOAA Weather Radio memories, marine VHF monitoring, and the first GMRS receive-only reference memories. (CH20-38)

Fixed_Base_3.description: GMRS monitoring, MURS / Dot reference memories, and the first national interoperability memories. (CH39-50)

Fixed_Base_4.description: Remaining national VHF/UHF interoperability receive-only reference memories. (CH51-57)

Local_Add-On_22191.description: Local ham repeaters near ZIP 22191, Woodbridge & Prince William County

Time_Standard_Stations.description: WWV, WWVH, and CHU time/frequency standard broadcasts. Receive-only reference. (CH158-169)
